sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost drivers behind your offer; we value our long relationship and appreciate the owner’s offer to walk us through the calculation. Larger price steps may need committee approval, so could you review the base price in light of our fixed full demand, the longer-term planning security and our rising forecast? We’ll set out our proposal on all terms below.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
In our call of 2026-09-04 (doc:20260904-70740-M1) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract and 45-day payment terms, which we are prepared to accommodate.
However, a fixed price over three years is not feasible given raw material volatility, so we must include an AS-14404 index clause.
In light of your forecast increase and our long-standing relationship, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit, and we are happy to schedule a meeting to walk you through the cost breakdown.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We cannot reduce the price further under these terms, so our offer remains at €5.40 per unit. Therefore, our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We would be glad to schedule a meeting to walk you through the calculation, and we kindly ask you to provide the data supporting your volume claims. We value working with you and look forward to your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
